name: Formula Car Racing Game
summary:
Get ready to feel the speed! 🏁

Formula Car Racing Game puts you directly behind the wheel of a powerful Formula-style race car in an immersive VR racing experience for Meta Quest. Feel the intensity of high-speed racing as you accelerate down the track, attack corners, and compete for the fastest lap.

Designed to deliver an exciting and accessible racing experience, the game lets you experience the thrill of Formula racing from the driver's seat. Every turn, straightaway, and braking zone becomes a test
